posts.note: 9 standard cards on page 1. The featured post is NOT duplicated here, so page 1 is 1 + 9 = all 10 real posts.

loadMore.note: A single 'Load more' pill, rendered for visual fidelity and DELIBERATELY INERT. The original is Finsweet CMS Load v1 pointed at page 2; this clone only holds the 10 real page-1 posts, so there is nothing to load and no extra posts are fabricated to give it something to reveal. It is an <a> with no href, role="button", aria-disabled="true" and a preventDefault click, inside a div[role=navigation][aria-label="List"]. Its CSS pins cursor:pointer so it looks identical to the original's real anchor while still doing nothing. A generated instance must not wire it to real pagination. There is no category filter, no tab bar and no search on this page.

constraints.noEmptyState: No .w-dyn-empty block exists in the original markup for either list, so none is rendered here (unlike /faq).

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. Global .btn hover transitions only.

responsive.desktop: plain .row/.col flex — no CSS grid and no gap. The 40px gutter and 40px row gap come entirely from .col{padding-inline:20px;margin-bottom:40px} over .row{margin-inline:-20px}. 3-up.
responsive.le991: still 3-up at 1024 (1024 > 991); cards go col-md-6 below that.

notes: Blog cards have NO hover state and NO transition. Do not add one.

The pill's metrics are a cascade accident preserved on purpose: .w-pagination-next's base font-size:14px beats .btn's 1rem, and because .btn expresses padding and radius in em the whole pill scales down to 110x40.5 with a 1386px radius. The clone wins this with a 0,2,0 selector (.w-pagination-next.btn) rather than relying on source order — see docs/CASCADE.md.

The hidden w-page-count still reads '1 / 4' because that is what the original ships; it describes the original collection, not this clone's 10 posts, and it is never visible or exposed to the a11y tree.
